questions: You list Samples S1 to S4 (p. 4). How many Hall bars did you measure in all, and how many showed the opposite-sign second-harmonic voltages on the two sides?
Why does the main text use Sample S1, and why were S3 and S4 measured only in the PPMS?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: currents other than 2 μA at 25 mK, field sweeps at gate voltages other than the five in Fig. 2, other cooldowns, and any tilted field?
What does the second-best device look like at 25 mK? S2 appears at two gate voltages and 1 μA (Extended Data Fig. 9); how do S3 and S4 compare at the gate voltages of Fig. 2?

How were the hysteretic second-harmonic sweeps antisymmetrized in field (which up and down branches were paired), which lock-in phase did you record, and could you show the raw left and right voltages behind Fig. 1e?

What is the capacitance per area of the SrTiO3 back gate at 25 mK, did you repeat the ground swap of Extended Data Fig. 3 at 25 mK and other gate voltages, and did you measure the second Hall pair (electrodes 3 and 5)?
What temperature rise do you estimate at 2 μA (25 mK) and at 5 μA (1.7 K)?

You describe the C2z symmetry of your Hall bars as approximate (p. 11). What are the resistances of the pressed indium contacts, and how symmetric are the scratched Hall bars in shape and contact placement?
